One grid. Your fastest finish.
Classic, friendly races, and Solana competitions.

scenes.body:
Classic needs no wallet.

scenes.title: Race a friend
scenes.body:
Create a Practice room and share the code.
No wallet. No tokens moved.

scenes.title: Compete on one grid
scenes.body:
Free rooms use a wallet message.
Each wallet gets one timed attempt.

scenes.title: Choose your entry
scenes.body:
1, 2, or 5 Soldoku—or a custom amount.
New funded entry is currently paused.

Verified Seeker test: 1 token per entrant.
Scheduled settlement; winner claimed 2.

The unique fastest valid finish wins.
Ties or no finishes return entrants’ stakes.
